changes.before: Guo et al. (2017) explain that a high model score does not always mean a high chance of being correct. Calibration helps confidence scores match actual accuracy better. In our web demo, the score is not shown as the probability of an image being AI generated. Choosing a threshold does not turn the score into a probability.
